description: Read/write Google Tasks: create, update, complete, delete, move tasks and lists, with due dates.
name: io.github.girmmy/google-tasks

environmentVariables.description: Path to your downloaded Google OAuth desktop-client JSON. Defaults to ~/.config/google-tasks-mcp-server/client_secret.json
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_TASKS_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Path where the cached OAuth token is stored. Defaults to ~/.config/google-tasks-mcp-server/token.json
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_TASKS_TOKEN_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Loopback port used only during the one-time authorization flow. Defaults to 53682
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_TASKS_OAUTH_PORT
